auditor_gonzalez: Morning team — quick ask for SOC2 fieldwork: a compact evidence drop showing RBAC changes (last 90 days), one traced example (PR -> approval -> CI -> kube audit -> KMS), service-account deprovs, and vuln ticket crosswalk. Drop by EOD?

kai_sec: We can do that. Preferred package: CSV of RBAC deltas + one traced folder + kms_events.csv + sa_deprov.csv + control_map.md + README.

rory_oncall: I'll generate rolebinding_changes.csv with columns: pr_id, author, approver, cluster, binding, principals_added, principals_removed, jira_or_na. ETA 16:30 PT.

lee_infra: For kube audit I'll pull apiserver events. Splunk query I'll run:

```splunk
index=k8s_audit ("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding") | where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | table _time user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace annotations.pr_id requestID
```

lee_infra: For KMS (AWS) Athena query: eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Encrypt','Decrypt') filtered by keyId/principal. I'll export CSV with ISO8601 timestamps.

auditor_gonzalez: Good. Need one fully traced example showing matching timestamps across PR, CI, kube audit, and KMS. PR screenshot with approver + timestamp is required.

kai_sec: Noted. We'll pick a recent change tied to JIRA SEC-5331 and include a 2-line remediation summary in the CSV. Other rows will be N/A where not applicable.

rory_oncall: Also adding timeline.csv to make correlation easy: event_time_iso, component, actor, action, evidence_path.

lee_infra: Uploading preliminary bundle to presigned link: https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/7000007777_drop (valid 48h). Contains rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/{pr.png,ci_log.txt,kube_audit_snip.txt,kms_row.csv}, sa_deprov.csv, control_map.md, README.txt.

packager-bot: artifact uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/7000007777_bundle.zip (expires in 48h) :package:

kai_sec: README lists kai_sec as primary contact and explains filenames. We'll ensure all timestamps include timezone offsets.

auditor_gonzalez: Thanks — i'll download and spot-check. If I need clarification i'll post here. :thumbsup:
